Menu.OpenPanelHint: Open the TableCodex Sync panel for session capture, export, and sync.

ApiUrl.Name: TableCodex API URL
ApiUrl.Hint: Base URL of your TableCodex instance (e.g. https://app.tablecodex.com).

ApiToken.Name: API Token
ApiToken.Hint: Your TableCodex API token. Found in TableCodex → Settings → Integrations.

Enabled.Name: Enable Capture
Enabled.Hint: Master switch for telemetry capture. When off, no events are recorded even during a session.

CaptureRolls.Name: Capture Rolls
CaptureRolls.Hint: Record dice rolls from chat messages (system-agnostic).

CaptureDnd5e.Name: Capture D&D5e Activity
CaptureDnd5e.Hint: Record D&D5e activity, spell, weapon, feature, and resource usage. Ignored on non-dnd5e systems.

CaptureMidi.Name: Capture Midi-QOL Enrichment
CaptureMidi.Hint: When Midi-QOL is installed, record high-fidelity attack/damage/save outcomes.

Notify.SessionResumed: A TableCodex session in progress was resumed after reload.
Notify.SessionPendingExport: A finished TableCodex session is pending export.
